title: Collectio Prima Decretorum Pontificum Romanorum
author: Dionysius Exiguus

passages.original: Quod gratia Dei non solum peccata dimittat, sed etiam adjuvet ne committantur, et præstat ut lex impleatur, non sicut ait Pelagius facile, quasi sine gratia Dei difficilius possit impleri.
passages.english: That the grace of God not only forgives sins but also helps [us] so that they are not committed, and grants that the law be fulfilled, not, as Pelagius says, "easily," as though without the grace of God it could be fulfilled [only] with greater difficulty.
passages.notes: This appears to be a chapter heading (cf. the canons of the Council of Carthage of 418 against Pelagianism). The subjunctive "dimittat" alongside the indicative "præstat" is kept as in the text; the sense is unaffected.
